what: Phrases that must not appear in a published file, stored as parts so that this file carries none of them. The lock tests/security/test_public_snapshot_excludes_private_material.py joins the parts and scans the index; the publisher's scratch test in the agentic-setup repository joins the same parts and checks that its private pattern file catches each phrase, in its plain form and in three altered forms. A phrase is the concatenation of its parts. The numbering phrases are the target's name, then one separator from 'before', then the stem, then one separator from 'after', then the number.
